mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy cycle, which reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected surge in the CPIAUCSL index above 234 triggers a sharp increase in inflation expectations, causing investors to demand higher risk premiums on equities and resulting in negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not turn negative within 5 trading days of the CPIAUCSL crossing, or the inflation surprise is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDPC1 (demand) and decline in FEDFUNDS (monetary) signals robust economic growth and accommodative policy, amplifying equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to rise above baseline in 60-day windows where both GDPC1 and FEDFUNDS meet the trigger condition, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained drop in FEDFUNDS below 1.5% signals aggressive monetary easing, which reduces long-term interest rates and boosts equity valuations, driving positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-positive despite FEDFUNDS falling below 1.5% in the late-cycle expansion regime, or the easing signal is not accompanied by a sustained drop in long-term rates (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising PAYEMS (job growth) indicates strengthening labor markets, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns fail to rise above baseline when PAYEMS increases, or the job growth is not statistically significant (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A peak in INDPRO above 101.0 signals tight supply conditions, prompting price increases and reduced corporate profits, which depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not turn negative within 5 days of INDPRO peaking, or the peak is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in GDPC1 (demand) and decline in UNRATE (lower unemployment) strengthens economic momentum, enhancing equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns fail to rise above baseline when both GDPC1 and UNRATE meet the trigger condition, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery, a sustained drop in FEDFUNDS below 1.0% signals aggressive monetary easing, which reduces long-term rates and accelerates equity appreciation, driving positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-positive despite FEDFUNDS falling below 1.0% in the post-shock recovery regime, or the easing signal is not accompanied by a sustained drop in long-term rates (p > 0.05).
